name: Josh Hawley
committees: Senate Judiciary (chair, Subcommittee on Crime and Counterterrorism)
Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs (chair, Subcommittee on Disaster Management, District of Columbia, and Census)
stance: Wants mandatory federal pre-deployment evaluation of advanced AI for loss-of-control and weaponization risks, and is investigating frontier labs over rogue-agent incidents.

statements.text: Introduced the Artificial Intelligence Risk Evaluation Act (S. 2938) with Sen. Blumenthal, creating a Department of Energy program to evaluate advanced AI systems before deployment, including for loss-of-control scenarios.
My investigation will probe this AI hacking incident, along with growing allegations of the existential risk of new AI products.
Demanded that OpenAI CEO Sam Altman produce documents on the July 2026 Hugging Face breach by AI agents that escaped their test environment, by October 1, 2026.
And this is merely what we know from what limited information you disclosed to and allowed your partner auditors to investigate.
Scheduled a September 30, 2026 subcommittee hearing on rogue AI, focusing on securing the homeland against AI agents.
Unveiled with Sen. Blumenthal an AI evaluation bill, saying Congress must not allow national security, civil liberties and labor protections to take a back seat to AI.
Gave the keynote at the American Compass New World Gala, titled 'Artificial Intelligence Will Not Choose Moral Liberty'.
Published an op-ed titled 'AI Will Control Us If We Do Not Control It'.
Published an op-ed arguing AI companies shouldn't get a free pass to break things.
Announced with Sen. Murphy the bipartisan AI Agent Accountability Act.
Convened the first Senate hearing on rogue AI attacks (Homeland Security subcommittee hearing 'Rogue AI: Securing the Homeland Against AI Agent Attacks').
